grid: Friday XKRX sessions only; diagnostics, NOT a replacement of proposal.json's issuer-specific annual event schedule. eventDue separately preserves that schedule.
membership: Use same-close or most recent past monthly KRX Top300 ranking, exact ranks 1..120. Never use a future snapshot, rank121 substitute, current constituents or forward-price survivors. Carry-forward is explicitly not a same-day market-wide Top120 ranking. Missing current-month snapshot blocks and retains prior names; missing rank slots retain expected denominator.
publication: Both separate consecutive annual filings must be strictly public before signal date. No same-day timestamp assumption, skipped-year bridge or late comparative-column backfill. Original receipt mismatch is a reason, never a splice.
vintage: Verify hashed original DART listing/main bytes. Original financial vintage requires separately retained original XBRL package on the exact receipt, matching numeric facts, issuer, statement basis, units and context. Metadata alone never certifies original amounts.
fiscalWindows: Original revenue duration must cover a full 12-calendar-month window ending at its reported month-end, with stock balance on the same end. Current/prior windows must be adjacent. No January-December inference from fiscalYear alone. 52/53-week and other unsupported windows abstain.
identity: Raw annual identity must match dated original listing/main corpCode and security stock code; both annual legs same issuer; signal-snapshot name exact after legal suffix/whitespace normalization. No current-directory mapping, preferred/common substitution, successor splice or unproven rename.
industry: Reparse retained official KIND notice and header bytes, verify hashes, match stated stock code, notice date and effective date. Use latest already-public effective after-label only. Link the notice issuer to original annual identity PUBLIC BEFORE THE NOTICE, then require same corpCode at signal. Current anchors and future before-labels remain diagnostic reconstruction only. Last disclosed label is not proof of exhaustive change-history coverage.
trading: Project contemporaneous signal-session close/volume only; preserve missing and zero-volume rows. No future price, holding return, next-open execution certification or terminal consideration assumption.
termination: All intended members remain. Last trading date itself stays live; after it, mark ended identity while retaining row. Eventual future termination is audit context only and cannot filter prior signals. No terminal payoff calculation.
receipts: One intended membership digest per signal, bound to signal date and source snapshot; every emitted (signal,ticker) must appear exactly once. Full row/cohort bytes, source SHA/size and code SHA are recorded; hashes do not confer owner authorization.
coverage: Expected and retained member-date denominators, unknown rank slots, all nonexclusive missing reasons, per-year and per-signal stages; distinguish readability, original metadata, dated identity, dated industry issuer, original financial facts and full input admission.
sourceDemand: Original-package retrieval worklist selected only by input coverage. It is not an investment sample; do not drop other intended names or relax sample minima.
cli: Default PLAN_ONLY with zero source reads. --inspect --output requires a new output directory; status admission-blocked exits3, infrastructure/source failures exit4. --verify checks own input receipts only.
